source_and_internal_work.accounting: L0 ideal source work, internal PRE transfer and VDD supply energy are separate, never summed. Internal PRE work is not another external supply.
N ideal source work and VDD supply work are external; real L0 output-to-gate and PRE work are internal transfers. Never sum internal transfers as external supplies.

source_leading_positive.interpretation: Signed total terminal currents establish local flow direction; no intrinsic Cgd/channel/diode fraction is identified.
